about: Reference recordings measured by measure.py. All are Speech Accent Archive readings of the same elicitation paragraph ('Please call Stella...'), George Mason University, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (https://accent.gmu.edu/download). Audio is downloaded to a temp dir outside the repo and deleted after measuring; only these references and the numbers are committed. Glasgow 'otter' lines are the game's own ElevenLabs lines (public/assets/audio/scotland).
passage: Please call Stella. Ask her to bring these things with her from the store: Six spoons of fresh snow peas, five thick slabs of blue cheese, and maybe a snack for her brother Bob. We also need a small plastic snake and a big toy frog for the kids. She can scoop these things into three red bags, and we will go meet her Wednesday at the train station.

not_measured.multicultural_toronto_english: YouTube refused downloads from the research machine on 2026-11-15 ('Sign in to confirm you're not a bot'), so no MTE clip was measured. Candidate clips with timestamps are in ../sources.json (acoustic_candidate: true). Re-run with: python3 measure.py --youtube <url> <start-end> <label>
